import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from tiny3d.animation_quality import canonical_sha256, verify_rendered_deformation_evidence
rows={
'moth':('037d93718da721d3298780717f25b8dfbb85b452f8e0b020f581ff98766e379c','quality_receipt.json'),
'ethereal':('8fa70e5f7a18a88e6f5b122df8fb7ac53a452e6bc1228b4d1a66495868682a4f','quality_receipt.json'),
'raincoat':('33556cd91070d2797ab5d2570367c166f307a5a56d70abe42d3d2925934d0075','quality_receipt.json'),
}
lib=Path(r'C:\Users\Lauri\Desktop\Tiny3D_LIBRARY')
work=Path(r'C:\Users\Lauri\Desktop\issue306_work')
for name,(aid,qfile) in rows.items():
    asset=lib/aid
    quality=json.loads((work/name/qfile).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    evidence=json.loads((asset/'receipts/rendered_deformation_evidence.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    stored=json.loads((asset/'receipts/rendered_deformation_verification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    contract=json.loads((asset/'receipts/showcase_animation_contract.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    glb=asset/'derivatives/showcase_skeletal/asset.glb'
    h=hashlib.sha256(glb.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    recomputed_id=canonical_sha256({k:v for k,v in quality.items() if k!='quality_receipt_id'})
    try:
        replay=verify_rendered_deformation_evidence(quality,evidence,asset/'evidence/rendered_deformation')
        replay_error=None
    except Exception as exc:
        replay={}; replay_error=str(exc)
    print(json.dumps({
      'name':name,'asset_id':aid,'derivative_sha':h,
      'quality_source_sha':quality.get('source_sha256'),
      'quality_state':quality.get('numeric_quality_state'),
      'quality_receipt_id':quality.get('quality_receipt_id'),
      'quality_id_matches':quality.get('quality_receipt_id')==recomputed_id,
      'clip_states':{r.get('animation_name'):r.get('state') for r in quality.get('clips',[])},
      'contract_evidence':contract.get('evidence'),
      'stored_verification_id':stored.get('verification_id'),'stored_accepted':stored.get('accepted'),
      'replay_verification_id':replay.get('verification_id'),'replay_accepted':replay.get('accepted'),
      'replay_matches_stored':replay==stored,'replay_error':replay_error,
    },indent=2,sort_keys=True))
